claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the product for defining waves and curls while leaving hair soft and light without stickiness or heaviness.
A recurring complaint is that the pump, cap, or nozzle breaks or fails to dispense, sometimes immediately or before the bottle is finished.
Several reviewers note the product is expensive, and some question authenticity or age of bottles bought from third-party sellers.
Users caution about portion control, noting that using slightly too much can make hair stiff or sticky.
Some reviewers mention the pleasant scent as a positive attribute.
